name: Imitation Lover
source:
Game encompasses the lives of Kurusu Itsuki as the first protagonist, and his best friend, Kidou Naoya as the second protagonist. Itsuki is a bit of a loner, and a bit on the emo side at that (kind of gloomy, not well-spoken and with a bit of an inferiority complex); he's basically Shinji Ikari moved from Evangelion into a random ero game, with a new haircut and glasses. Despite this, he is best friends with Naoya, who happens to be one of the most popular guys in school (as in, girls contantly ask him out and proposition him for things, even older girls). Itsuki's life takes a rather interesting turn when one Ichinose Kyo approaches him. Kyo in this story is a girl with a bad reputation, though she doesn't seem to mind the negative attention. Either way, she asks Itsuki to help her cheat at some exams that are coming up. In return, Kyo offers her virginity. As simple (and pointless) as this may sound, this set up leads to an emotional rollercoaster for Itsuki, not to mention the two girls he can end up with and the third girl that can potentially ruin his life. Aside from Kyo, both Sonomura Madoka (Kyo's childhood friend) and Kirisawa Iori (Naoya's would-be girlfriend) have a ton of emotional baggage that the player will get to witness, regarless of who Itsuki goes after. 

[From [url=https://moroboshiyuumei.livejournal.com/11649.html]Moroboshi Yuumei blog[/url]]
translation:
遊戲圍繞著兩個主角展開：第一主角栗棲樹和他最好的朋友鬼道直也。樹有點獨來獨往，性格偏陰鬱（不太愛說話，有些自卑情結）；他基本上就是《新世紀福音戰士》裡的碇真嗣搬到了隨便哪一款成人遊戲裡，換個髮型，再戴副眼鏡。儘管如此，他和直也是最好的朋友——直也恰好是學校裡最受歡迎的男生（女生們不斷向他告白、提出各種要求，甚至學姊也是如此）。當一之瀨京出現在樹面前時，他的人生發生了有趣的轉折。京在這個故事裡是一個名聲不好的女孩，但她似乎並不在意這些負面關注。總之，她請求樹幫她在即將到來的考試中作弊。作為回報，京獻出了她的處女之身。雖然聽起來很簡單（也很無謂），但這個設定給樹帶來了一段情感雲霄飛車之旅，更不用說他可能在一起的兩個女孩和可能毀掉他人生的第三個女孩了。除了京，園村圓（京的青梅竹馬）和桐澤伊織（直也的準女友）都有著沉重的情感包袱，無論樹選擇追求誰，玩家都會親眼見識到。

[出自[url=https://moroboshiyuumei.livejournal.com/11649.html]Moroboshi Yuumei部落格[/url]]
